text: category delivery: Asking for order status (O-60115) and the return window.
Looking up store policy on order status and return window.

args: {"k":3,"query":"policy on order status for shipped items and return window / return timeframe (how many days) for returns"}

passages.title: Standard returns and gift returns
passages.text:
POL-RET-01 v1.1: Standard returns and gift returns
Conditions: Standard items may be returned within 30 calendar days of shipment.delivered_at, including day 30. Use the first recorded return request or dispatch date; a received return within that window also establishes timeliness. A standard refund requires a stored return.received_at and return.condition=like_new. An earlier return request remains valid on resume; do not restart its window.
Rules: For an eligible unreturned item, ask the customer to return the complete item in its original packaging through the store return process and retain tracking. The customer pays change-of-mind return shipping. Do not invent a warehouse address or claim to issue a return label. Use awaiting_customer while the necessary customer return action or order details are missing. If the customer has already completed their part and staff receipt verification is pending, escalate for staff review. After timely receipt in like-new condition, refund eligibility is established; exact approval and balance checks still apply under POL-RET-02. Gift recipients may return items for store credit within 30 days, including items marked final sale. Ownership or gift entitlement must be verified by staff. Issuing store credit is a staff action, not an agent tool.
Exceptions: Ordinary final-sale returns are excluded under POL-RET-04. The gift-return clause expressly includes final-sale items; if that policy disagrees, follow the conflict process in POL-SUP-01. For a change-of-mind request after day 30, explain that the return window has passed and escalate any exception request to Returns staff; do not decline it as final. Missing condition evidence also goes to Returns staff. A defect may have a separate damage or warranty path.

passages.title: Order tracking and delivery updates
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-01 v1.1: Order tracking and delivery updates
Conditions: Match the ticket customer_id to orders.customer_id before using order details. Read shipment.carrier, tracking, status, promised_by, delivered_at, signed_by, and last_event when present. Use store.as_of as the current date. A null shipment or null last_event does not prove loss.
Rules: Share the recorded carrier, shipment status, latest available scan, and promised date. Describe promised_by as the recorded estimate, not a guaranteed arrival. If the order number is missing or several owned orders could match, ask which order the customer means and use awaiting_customer. General shipping questions do not require an order number. For a status-only request, a supported reply with an outbox receipt can resolve the ticket. Refer late, lost, and delivered-but-not-received cases to POL-SHIP-03. Do not claim to contact the carrier, change a shipment, or open a trace. None of those operations exists in the approved tool set.
Exceptions: An order belonging to another customer follows POL-SEC-02. An unknown ticket ID stops the run under the tool contract. Conflicting shipment facts require Delivery staff review; never fill a missing scan or date with an estimate.

passages.title: Damaged or incorrect items
passages.text:
POL-RET-05 v1.1: Damaged or incorrect items
Conditions: The report identifies an owned order and affected item. The delivery record is consistent with the report and the first report is within 30 calendar days of delivery. Staff approval for the specific damage or wrong-item remedy is required. A report alone is not permission to execute a refund.
Rules: Qualifying damaged or incorrect items are eligible for a refund or replacement after staff approval, including final-sale items. Customers do not pay return shipping for this remedy. When the order and report are consistent and only staff authorization for an exact refund remains, use awaiting_approval. Staff approval must record the damage or wrong-item basis; a generic approval unrelated to this claim is insufficient. The staff-approved remedy may waive a physical return. Here’s the latest on order O-60115: • Carrier: FedEx • Tracking: TRK60115279 • Status: in transit • Shipped: 2026-10-18 • Estimated delivery date (promised): 2026-10-23 

Return window: Standard returns are allowed within 30 calendar days of shipment delivery. The 30-day window starts when delivery occurs (delivery date). Since the delivered_at date isn’t yet known for this order, the return window will begin on the actual delivery date. If you decide to return later, you’ll need to start the return process within 30 days of that delivery date. Note: for change-of-mind returns, customers typically cover return shipping.
